instructions: 只編輯 target_zh_TW 與 translator_note。空白 target 匯出時保留英文；這份 JSON 不是遊戲原生格式。

entries.source:
This mission demonstrates
the effectiveness of the
Y-wing as a commerce
raider as you destroy
an Imperial convoy.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在這次任務中，
你將摧毀一支帝國船團，
親身體驗Y翼戰機
作為商船突襲機的
強大效能。

entries.source: Several cargo containers are being readied for shipment by space tugs.
entries.target_zh_TW: 數個貨櫃正由太空拖船準備裝運。

entries.source: A number of freighters will arrive to dock with the containers.
entries.target_zh_TW: 數艘貨船將抵達，與這些貨櫃對接。

entries.source: Y-wings from [[Red Squadron]] will pop up out of hyperspace here.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色中隊]]的Y翼戰機將在此脫離超空間現身。

entries.source: [[Destroy ]]all containers and freighters to disrupt Imperial commerce.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[摧毀]]所有貨櫃與貨船，打亂帝國的商貿。

entries.source: Be alert to the arrival of new ships. Withdraw if they are warships.
entries.target_zh_TW: 留意新抵達的艦艇。如果是戰艦，立即撤退。

entries.source: Commerce raiding is a fundamental tactic of the Rebellion.  Without the armament to match the Empire's military might, we must strike them where they are most vulnerable.  This is at the source of Imperial power...its commerce!  By disrupting trade we can undermine the Empire and its control of entire sectors of space.  Through [["Hit and Fade"]] raids we deny the Empire its very lifeblood and weaken the strength of the Imperial Fleet.
entries.target_zh_TW: 商船突襲是反抗軍的基本戰術。我們缺乏足以匹敵帝國軍力的武裝，因此必須攻擊他們最脆弱之處。那就是帝國力量的根源……商貿！只要擾亂貿易，就能削弱帝國及其對整片星區的控制。透過[[「打帶跑」]]突襲，我們斷絕帝國的命脈，並削弱帝國艦隊的實力。

entries.source: Though the Alliance desperately needs the very ships and supplies we are destroying, we lack the resources to execute large scale "[[liberations]]" of Imperial equipment.  In this mission two pilots from Red Squadron were able to destroy a large convoy of valuable freighters and containers left momentarily unprotected at a staging area in the [[Bonadan System]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 雖然聯盟極度需要我們正在摧毀的這些艦船與物資，但我們缺乏資源，無法大規模「[[解放]]」帝國裝備。在這次任務中，紅色中隊的兩名飛行員在[[博納丹星系]]的一處集結區，成功摧毀了一支暫時無人保護、由貴重貨船與貨櫃組成的大型船團。

entries.source: Use your [[sensors]] and the [[targeting system ]]to "fix" your targets and plan your attack.  Remember your torpedoes are your most powerful weapon so use them wisely.  Weaken each container or freighter with a torpedo first, then finish it off with your lasers.  Shift [[power]] as needed to keep your lasers fully charged.  Keep destroying the Empire's materiel until the arrival of the Frigate then withdraw!
entries.target_zh_TW: 運用你的[[感測器]]與[[瞄準系統]]「鎖定」目標，並規劃攻擊方式。記住，魚雷是你最強大的武器，要善加運用。先用一枚魚雷削弱每個貨櫃或貨船，再用雷射砲解決它。視需要調配[[能量]]，讓雷射砲保持滿充能。持續摧毀帝國的物資，直到巡防艦抵達，然後撤退！

entries.source: All valuable containers and freighters have been destroyed
entries.target_zh_TW: 所有貴重貨櫃與貨船均已摧毀

entries.source:
In this mission you will
learn to track and destroy
enemy starfighters.  Use all 
of the Y-wing's weapons to
destroy as many Imperial
craft as you can.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在這次任務中，你將
學會追蹤並摧毀
敵方星際戰機。
運用Y翼戰機的所有武器，
盡可能摧毀
更多帝國艦艇。

entries.source: Destroy all [[Imperial]] fighters lined up to be evaluated.
entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀所有排列待測的[[帝國]]戰機。

entries.source: The Empire routinely enhances their TIE ([[Twin Ion Engine]]) starfighter models.  The new prototypes are secretly tested at a hidden base.  There, Imperial pilots thoroughly test the new features of the TIE Fighters, Interceptors, and Bombers before reporting the results back to Imperial Command.$  The discovery of one of these bases by [[Wedge Antilles]] was an unexpected bonus for the Alliance.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國經常改良旗下的鈦（TIE，[[雙離子引擎]]）星際戰機。新原型機會在一座隱密基地秘密測試。帝國飛行員在那裡全面測試鈦戰機、鈦攔截機與鈦轟炸機的新功能，再將結果回報給帝國指揮部。$  [[韋奇·安提利斯]]發現了其中一座基地，對聯盟而言是意外的收穫。

entries.source: [[Use]] your front and rear sensors to quickly target enemy TIE fighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[運用]]前方與後方感測器，迅速鎖定敵方鈦戰機。

entries.source: [[Optimize]] your power distribution to your engine, lasers, and shields.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[最佳化]]分配至引擎、雷射砲與護盾的能量。

entries.source: [[Use]] your ion and laser guns to [[rapidly]] disable and destroy crafts.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[運用]]離子砲與雷射砲，[[迅速]]癱瘓並摧毀敵艦。

entries.source: This mission recreates the attack following his discovery.  A lone Y-wing was sent in to destroy the prototypes as they were being unloaded from their containers, and then hyper out before any retaliation could be organized by the Empire.$  Use your [[sensors]] to quickly locate the enemy starfighters. Learn to [[lead]] targets with your lasers and destroy all of them before hyperspacing home.$
entries.target_zh_TW: 這次任務重現了他發現基地後的那場攻擊。一架Y翼戰機單獨出擊，趁原型機從貨櫃中卸下時將其摧毀，並在帝國組織反擊之前躍遷離開。$  運用你的[[感測器]]迅速找出敵方星際戰機的位置。學會以雷射砲對目標打出[[提前量]]，在躍遷返航前將它們全數摧毀。$

entries.source: Prototypes of new TIEs are being unloaded and prepared for testing.
entries.target_zh_TW: 新型鈦戰機的原型機正在卸貨並準備進行測試。

entries.source: Some of the fighters will already be undergoing basic maneuver evaluation.
entries.target_zh_TW: 部分戰機已在進行基本機動評估。

entries.source: Y-wing [[Red Two]] will pop up here and immediately attack the [[TIEs]].
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色二號]]將在此現身，並立即攻擊[[鈦戰機]]。

entries.source: You have destroyed all prototype starfighters
entries.target_zh_TW: 你已摧毀所有原型星際戰機
護衛艦卡琳號發出求救信號

entries.source:
This mission will require
you to use your proton 
torpedoes to stop an 
Imperial attack against a 
neutral Corvette.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在這次任務中，
你必須使用質子魚雷，
阻止帝國對一艘
中立護衛艦的
攻擊。
>提列克人護衛艦卡琳號發出求救信號

entries.source: A [[Twi'lek]] delegation to the Alliance is under Imperial attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一個前往聯盟的[[提列克人]]代表團正遭到帝國攻擊。

entries.source: Y-wings from [[Red Squadron]] will pop up behind the TIEs and attack them.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色中隊]]的Y翼戰機將在鈦戰機後方現身並發動攻擊。

entries.source: This should put you in an ideal position to surprise the [[Imperials.]]
entries.target_zh_TW: 這應能讓你處於絕佳位置，出其不意地襲擊[[帝國軍]]。

entries.source: Destroy all [[TIE Bombers]] to protect the Twi'lek delegation.
entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀所有[[鈦轟炸機]]，保護提列克人代表團。

entries.source: This mission recreates a critical moment in the Rebel Alliance's relationship with the [[Twi'leks]].  A delegation of Twi'leks had just left their home world bound for secret negotiations with the [[Alliance High Command]].  Imperial spies had learned of the meeting and planned to ambush the Twi'lek ship en route to the summit.$  Only a small force was sent to attack the unescorted Corvette.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這次任務重現了反抗軍聯盟與[[提列克人]]關係中的關鍵時刻。一個提列克人代表團剛離開母星，準備與[[聯盟最高指揮部]]進行秘密談判。帝國間諜得知這場會面，計畫在提列克人的船前往會談途中伏擊。$  帝國只派出一支小部隊攻擊這艘沒有護航的護衛艦。

entries.source: The [[Star Destroyer]] Avenger dropped out of hyperspace long enough to hastily deploy a squadron of TIE Bombers; then abruptly departed.$  [[Alliance Counter-Intelligence]] had learned of the impending ambush, but was only able to send out two Y-wings to aid the Twi'leks.  Thanks to this timely intervention, their ship escaped and the grateful delegation soon agreed to join the Alliance!
entries.target_zh_TW: [[滅星者]]復仇者號短暫脫離超空間，匆忙部署一個中隊的鈦轟炸機後便倏然離去。$  [[聯盟反情報部]]已得知這場迫在眉睫的伏擊，卻只能派出兩架Y翼戰機援助提列克人。多虧這次及時的介入，他們的船成功脫逃，心懷感激的代表團不久便同意加入聯盟！

entries.source: You and your wingman will hyperspace in behind the TIE Bombers to take them by surprise.  Destroy them as quickly as you can to prevent them from launching any [[torpedoes]] at the Twi'lek Corvette.  Be sure to use your sensor displays to watch behind you.  You don't want to fall victim to the same tactic you're using!$  The Twi'lek Corvette should reach its hyperspace point in about [[7 minutes]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 你和你的僚機將躍遷至鈦轟炸機後方，給它們來個出其不意。盡快將它們摧毀，以免它們對提列克人的護衛艦發射任何[[魚雷]]。務必利用感測器顯示留意後方。你可不想栽在自己正在使用的同一招戰術上！$  提列克人的護衛艦應會在大約 [[7 分鐘]]後抵達超空間躍遷點。

entries.source: [[Intercept]] any TIE Bombers launched from the Star Destroyer Avenger.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[攔截]]從滅星者復仇者號出動的所有鈦轟炸機。

entries.source: All TIE Bombers have been destroyed
entries.target_zh_TW: 所有鈦轟炸機均已摧毀
提列克人代表團向你致謝

entries.source:
In this mission you will
assist in the rescue of 
Rebel P.O.W.s.  Use your 
ion cannons to disable the 
Imperial Shuttles as quickly 
as possible.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在這次任務中，你將
協助營救
反抗軍戰俘。
使用離子砲
盡快癱瘓
帝國穿梭機。

entries.source: P.O.W.s are being moved from [[Kessel]] to the Star Destroyer [[Predator]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 戰俘正從[[凱瑟]]被押送至滅星者[[掠奪者號]]。

entries.source: There will only be a couple of TIE Fighters escorting the shuttles.
entries.target_zh_TW: 護送穿梭機的只有兩三架鈦戰機。

entries.source: [[Red Squadron's]] Y-wings will pop up behind the shuttles and disable them.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色中隊]]的Y翼戰機將在穿梭機後方現身並將其癱瘓。

entries.source: Alliance Intelligence had learned of a transfer of Rebel P.O.W.'s from the prison planet [[Kessel]]. [[ ]]There were to be five shuttle loads of prisoners delivered to the Star Destroyer [[Predator]].  Overconfidence led the Empire to believe two TIE fighters were an adequate escort.$  A bold rescue plan was conceived. The plan consisted of an equal number of Rebel shuttles and three Y-wings from [[Red Squadron]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟情報部得知，帝國將從監獄星球[[凱瑟]]轉移一批反抗軍戰俘。[[ ]]共有五架穿梭機載運的囚犯要送往滅星者[[掠奪者號]]。帝國過度自信，認為兩架鈦戰機就足以護航。$  我方構思出一項大膽的救援計畫。計畫動用同等數量的反抗軍穿梭機，以及[[紅色中隊]]的三架Y翼戰機。

entries.source: Once disabled, Rebel shuttles will arrive to free the prisoners.
entries.target_zh_TW: 穿梭機一旦被癱瘓，反抗軍穿梭機就會抵達釋放囚犯。

entries.source: Reinforcements from the [[Predator]] will be intercepted by the Y-wings.
entries.target_zh_TW: 來自[[掠奪者號]]的增援將由Y翼戰機負責攔截。

entries.source: The Y-wings attacked, disabling the enemy shuttles and destroying their escorts.  Then the rescue shuttles arrived to free the captives.  All the prisoners were freed and several TIE Interceptors from the [[Predator]] were destroyed.  The participating pilots were all awarded the [[Corellian Cross]] for their bravery.$  Don't let the Empire's fighters lure you away.  Securing the area during the rescue is your top priority.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼戰機發動攻擊，癱瘓了敵方穿梭機並摧毀其護航機。接著救援穿梭機抵達，釋放了俘虜。所有囚犯皆獲救，還有數架來自[[掠奪者號]]的鈦攔截機被擊毀。參與行動的飛行員全都因英勇表現獲頒[[柯瑞利亞十字勳章]]。$  別被帝國的戰機引開。救援期間確保該區域安全是你的首要任務。

entries.source: All shuttles have been intercepted, and the prisoners are safe
entries.target_zh_TW: 所有穿梭機均已被攔截，囚犯已安全

entries.source:
This mission shows why the
Y-wing is considered the
most versatile starfighter
in the galaxy. You'll learn
to escort Alliance ships
while engaging Imperial
forces.
entries.target_zh_TW:
這次任務將告訴你，
為什麼Y翼戰機被譽為
銀河中用途最廣的
星際戰機。你將學會
一邊護航聯盟艦艇，
一邊與帝國部隊
交戰。

entries.source: Rebel pilots have escaped [[Mytus VII]] by stowing away aboard a freighter.
entries.target_zh_TW: 反抗軍飛行員藏身於一艘貨船中，逃出了[[麥特斯七號星]]。

entries.source: [[Red Squadron]] will send two Y-wings and a shuttle to meet the freighter.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色中隊]]將派出兩架Y翼戰機與一架穿梭機，與貨船會合。

entries.source: An [[Imperial Frigate]] is in this sector and could arrive at any time.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一艘[[帝國巡防艦]]正在本星區，隨時可能抵達。

entries.source: If it does, [[shield]] the shuttle long enough to complete the rescue.
entries.target_zh_TW: 若它出現，就[[掩護]]穿梭機，直到救援完成。

entries.source: [[Mytus VII, ]]also known as the infamous[[ Star's End]], is the most dreaded prison world in the galaxy. Assisted by [[Alliance Intelligence]], two captured Rebel pilots escaped by stowing away aboard an outbound freighter.  A rescue team was sent to rendezvous with the freighter and free the prisoners.$  Time was limited as Imperial forces would be stopping and searching any craft they found in the area.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[麥特斯七號星]]，又稱惡名昭彰的[[星之盡頭]]，是銀河中最令人聞之色變的監獄星球。在[[聯盟情報部]]的協助下，兩名被俘的反抗軍飛行員藏身於一艘出港貨船中逃脫。我方派出救援小組與貨船會合，解救這些囚犯。$  時間有限，因為帝國部隊會攔截並搜查他們在該區域發現的任何艦艇。

entries.source: [[Intercept]] the Imperial forces and protect the rescue effort.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[攔截]]帝國部隊，保護救援行動。

entries.source: You must give the shuttle enough time to [[complete]] the rescue.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你必須給穿梭機足夠的時間來[[完成]]救援。

entries.source: An [[Imperial Frigate]] is nearby and can respond within moments.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一艘[[帝國巡防艦]]就在附近，轉眼間就能趕到。

entries.source: As you fly this mission be alert to Imperial intruders, especially [[Stormtrooper Transports]].  These will be carrying Imperial boarding parties and must be stopped!  Our own rescue team will require about [[3 minutes ]]to complete the rescue and will be very vulnerable during this period.
entries.target_zh_TW: 執行這次任務時，要提防帝國入侵者，尤其是[[風暴兵運輸艦]]。它們載有帝國登艦小隊，務必加以阻止！我方救援小組約需 [[3 分鐘]]完成救援，這段期間將非常脆弱。
救援行動非常出色，紅色一號！

entries.source:
This mission recreates one
of the most dramatic 
moments in Alliance history.
You will play a critiical 
role in the rescue of the
great Mon Calamari Admiral
Ackbar.
entries.target_zh_TW:
這次任務重現了
聯盟歷史上
最戲劇性的時刻之一。
你將在營救
偉大的蒙卡拉馬里人
阿克巴上將的行動中
扮演關鍵角色。

entries.source: [[Red Three]] will identify the officer's shuttle and disable it.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色三號]]將識別軍官搭乘的穿梭機，並將其癱瘓。

entries.source: Imperial shuttles are to rendezvous with the Frigate [[Vehemence.]]
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國穿梭機將與巡防艦[[狂暴號]]會合。

entries.source: The shuttles are being escorted by [[TIE Fighters.]]
entries.target_zh_TW: 這些穿梭機由[[鈦戰機]]護航。

entries.source: Y-wings from [[Red Squadron]] will pop up here and engage the escorts.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色中隊]]的Y翼戰機將在此現身，與護航機交戰。

entries.source: Shuttle [[Hasti]] will then arrive with the [[Commando unit]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 穿梭機[[哈絲蒂號]]隨後將載著[[突擊小隊]]抵達。

entries.source: Once the capture is completed all forces will withdraw into hyperspace.
entries.target_zh_TW: 俘獲完成後，所有部隊將撤入超空間。

entries.source: [[Blue Squadron's]] Y-wings will provide close escort for the Commandos.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[藍色中隊]]的Y翼戰機將為突擊隊提供近距離護航。

entries.source: This mission recreates the dramatic rescue of[[ ]]the great Mon Calamari leader [[Admiral Ackbar]].  Enslaved by the Empire, he was made a servant to Moff [[Tarkin]].  Recognition of his intelligence won him a staff position from which he was to learn about the enemy first-hand, becoming an expert on Imperial defenses and strategy.  He was freed during an interception of Shuttles in which the capture of Tarkin was attempted.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這次任務重現了營救[[ ]]偉大的蒙卡拉馬里領袖[[阿克巴上將]]的戲劇性行動。他遭帝國奴役，被迫成為[[塔金]]總督的僕役。由於才智受到賞識，他獲得了一個幕僚職位，得以親身了解敵人，進而成為帝國防禦與戰略的專家。他是在一次企圖俘虜塔金的穿梭機攔截行動中獲救的。

entries.source: Y-wings, with X-wings as escorts, were deployed to disable Tarkin's Shuttle.  Commandos aboard the Rebel Shuttle Hasti would then hyper into the area and carry out the mission.$  As it turned out, [[Tarkin]] narrowly escaped before the arrival of the Rebel assault.  However, the Alliance was able to capture the officers' shuttle with [[Ackbar]] on board.  His rescue was a boon the Alliance will long be grateful for!$
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼戰機在X翼戰機護航下出擊，負責癱瘓塔金的穿梭機。接著，反抗軍穿梭機哈絲蒂號上的突擊隊員將躍遷進入該區域執行任務。$  結果，[[塔金]]在反抗軍突擊部隊抵達前僥倖逃脫。不過，聯盟成功俘獲了載有[[阿克巴]]的軍官穿梭機。救出他對聯盟意義重大，聯盟將長久銘記這份恩惠！$

entries.source: As the Y-wing pilot your mission is to [[identify]] and [[disable]] the officers' Shuttle.  Once the Rebel Shuttle Hasti arrives, protect it from Imperial interference until the Commandos have completed their mission, then hyper home.$  To identify the proper Shuttle you will have to bring your Y-wing to within [[0.02]] kilometers of the target to determine its contents, so be careful and avoid collisions!
entries.target_zh_TW: 身為Y翼戰機飛行員，你的任務是[[識別]]並[[癱瘓]]軍官穿梭機。反抗軍穿梭機哈絲蒂號抵達後，保護它免受帝國干擾，直到突擊隊員完成任務，然後躍遷返航。$  要識別正確的穿梭機，你必須將Y翼戰機飛到距目標 [[0.02]] 公里內，才能判定其載運內容，所以要小心，避免碰撞！
